proposal.reason: Primary change removes CollNet execution from network backend/plugin/proxy paths (including CollNet transport implementation and loading). Additional substantive changes remove CollNet logical graph construction/connection and related topology metadata, disable CollNet in built-in algorithm/protocol tuning and enqueue fallback behavior, delete CollNet device-kernel instantiations while preserving reserved algorithm slot IDs, adjust generic transport/channel connection structures that previously carried CollNet-specific peers/patterns, and harden external tuner v1 handling by treating CollNet/out-of-range selections as unsupported and falling back to internal tuning.
